content: We need to determine number of aromatic carbon atoms in the compound. But we have no description of compound. Possibly the system expects us to retrieve NMR spectra and infer aromatic carbons? But we need the compound identity. Maybe the sample is implicit: the "sample at hand". We can get carbon NMR spectra which will list peaks, aromatic carbons appear around 120-150 ppm. Could count number of aromatic carbon signals. Use carbon_nmr_spectra tool. Let's call it.
